prompt: Use case: style-transfer. Asset type: one architectural heritage illustration for 访古. Image 1 is ONLY the STYLE MASTER, the existing Vairocana contour drawing. Image 2 and any further images are actual monument photographs and ONLY define subject geometry. Match the master's delicate, slightly organic thin black contours, sparse interior strokes, generous white surfaces and restrained visual density. Pure BLACK INK ON PURE WHITE. No black fills, shading, gray wash, hatching, pencil texture, dense brick or tile grids, color, text, labels, watermark or borders. Structural bays, eaves and silhouette must match the real monument. Reduce repetitive detail; do not trace every roof tile or brick. Openings stay white inside fine outlines. Complete apex and full base uncut, generous margins, centered near-frontal, reduced perspective. Remove tourists, trees, vegetation, fences, wires, vehicles, signs and surrounding modern structures. Ground consists of a few thin strokes.  SUBJECT: DANBO JINGCHENG HALL (Zhennan Wood Hall), the main palace hall in Chengde Mountain Resort, rebuilt in precious nanmu wood in 1754. Draw the actual very low broad SEVEN-BAY single-storey timber hall in image 2, with full surrounding veranda, slender plain round wooden columns, simple lintel beams and seven main groups of lattice panel doors. Roof is a SINGLE-eave HIP-AND-GABLE ROUNDED JUANPENG roof, WITHOUT a sharp ornamental main ridge or dragons; preserve its unusually simple broad low profile and gently curving corners. No double roof, no palace gold motifs, no extra pavilions. Reconstruct only continuation of the regular visible veranda columns behind the obstructing pine trunks, keeping seven structural bays. Low stone platform with three short frontal stairs. Landscape 1536x1024 near-frontal, hall about82percent width, complete left/right eaves. Remove all pine trees, surrounding buildings, visitors, vases and all plaques/calligraphy. Blank white roof planes, sparse thin strokes for selected ribs; door lattice lightly suggested not fully gridded. This is the humble-looking nanmu hall, do not replace with tall Forbidden City architecture.

site_recommendation.coordinate_source: 携程澹泊敬诚殿独立POI https://hk.trip.com/travel-guide/attraction/chengde/danbo-jingcheng-76717/ 的结构化数据坐标GCJ-02 40.983264,117.941597；按GCJ-02反算为WGS84约40.98170,117.93531，仅作图鉴近似定位。
site_recommendation.lede: 澹泊敬诚殿是避暑山庄正宫的主殿。卷棚歇山顶舒展开阔，未施浓重彩饰的楠木构架传达着山庄宫殿的朴素取向。

facts.label: 现存年代
facts.text: 康熙五十年（1711）始建，乾隆十九年（1754）以楠木改建；图鉴按现存主体1754年定位。

facts.label: 形制
facts.text: 面阔七间、进深三间，单檐卷棚歇山顶，殿前设开阔月台与踏跺。

facts.label: 收录范围
facts.text: 避暑山庄全园作为一处收录；本图仅以正宫澹泊敬诚殿代表，不混入后期亭阁。
